rationale: Standalone branch-vs-base review of PR #701 (EPMCDME-15411, 25 files / 2919+ / 71-, ~1271 lines of that in src/) run after this session's fourth review round of fixes. No spec/story artifact was supplied, so this is a no-spec round: the acceptance lens was not dispatched and confidence is forced to 'low' by design, independent of the code findings below. Blind and edge-case lenses ran as parallel subagents, both independently and correctly identified the same real defect (CR-007): resolveProfileWorkspace()'s isLocalProfile branch computed canUseSharedIdentity()'s origin/sibling check against `allProfiles?.[profileName]` from the GLOBAL profiles map, which is `{}` for a purely local-only profile with no same-named global entry — silently disabling the origin/sibling guard for that entire class of profiles (a local-only profile could inherit another environment's shared leftover codeMieUrl/codeMieProject despite a sibling provably claiming that origin for itself). The blind lens separately flagged a secondary, lower-severity asymmetry: statusline.ts's inline fallback gated only on `codeMieUrl` being falsy, not the full identity trio, diverging from config.ts's `ownHasAnyIdentity` atomic-trio gate. Both were fixed inline during this review round (not deferred): resolveProfileWorkspace() now derives the local branch's canUseSharedIdentity() check from the LOCAL profile's own stored provider/baseUrl (looked up via loadLocalMultiProviderConfig()), never an empty global stand-in; statusline.ts's fallback now also checks codeMieProject/codeMieIntegration before substituting the shared codeMieUrl. 2 new regression tests were added for each fix, written test-first (confirmed RED via a temporary git-stash revert of just the fix, then GREEN after restoring it). After the fixes: full affected-file suites green (config-project-override.test.ts, statusline.test.ts, migration 008 test all passing), full unit project green (6080 passed / 2 skipped, up from 6078/2 before this round), tsc --noEmit clean, eslint --max-warnings=0 clean, npm run build clean (including the statusline esbuild bundle). Live isolated verification against the compiled dist/ build (fresh CODEMIE_HOME per scenario, no mocks) confirmed CR-007's fix and re-confirmed AC5 (local-only profile with no sibling conflict still gets the permanent shared fallback) and CR-002 (same-named local/global profile pair still protected) have not regressed. No remaining blocking findings. Commit messages in range (36f1428a, 82fbf181, 41c8862c, dd337fe0, f879a7c1, 2d546eeb, 966b64d7, 3ebfc9ce, 443fcc52, 90a894ce) all follow the documented `type(scope): subject` Conventional Commits format. No `defer`/`dismiss` findings from this round's lenses beyond the two fixed inline.
